raw_segments.text: Hamlet. No faith, not a jot. But to follow him thither with modesty enough, and likelihood
to lead it, as thus. Alexander died, Alexander was buried, Alexander
returneth into dust. The dust is earth. Of earth we make loam, and why of that loam where
too he was converted might they not stop a beer barrel? Imperious Caesar, dead and turned
to clay, might stop a hole to keep the wind away. Oh, that that earth which kept the world
in awe should patch a wall tea expel the winter's flaw. But soft.
But soft, aside, here comes the king.
